scope: Exploratory sensitivity check after observing six-connected component results; specified before any26-connected results.
rule: Retain largest predicted component separately per target using all26 native-grid neighbors (faces,edges,corners); deterministic first raster component on ties; no reference use for component selection. Compare with already-fixed six-neighbor results.
interpretation: Tests sensitivity to diagonal connectivity, not physical or anatomical correctness; cannot use this test to replace the original metric or select a postprocessing rule.
